title: UCS: A Universal Model for Curvilinear Structure Segmentation
mechanism: Sparse adapters in a SAM encoder, an FFT high-pass prompt generator for curve-specific prompts, and a prompt-free decoder with hierarchical feature compression; tuned for cross-domain curvilinear segmentation.
adaptation: Crack-only branch fused with house multi-class output; high-pass prompts will also fire on gridlines, busbar edges and scuffs, so keep the multi-class context and check false alarms on half-cut E1 cells.
evidence: R: SOTA generalisation and open-set curvilinear segmentation across medical, engineering, natural, plant imagery (abstract).
min_experiment: UCS crack branch, 3 seeds, crack logits replace house crack logits; metric crack IoU, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2; kill if both < house + 0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Replicate the 1-channel EL image to 3 channels and upsample 512 to 1024. Fine-tune a crack-only head first, then add other classes.
alt_notes.min_experiment: UCS crack-only vs house crack-only, 2 seeds, 20k steps. Metrics: test crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2. Kill if both are below house.
